relations.text: NVIDIAとの協業を拡大し、OCI SuperclusterでNVIDIA GB200 NVL72システムを提供
relations.text_en: Oracle expanded its collaboration with NVIDIA, offering NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 systems on OCI Supercluster

source.label: Oracle の発表
source.quote: Oracle has expanded its collaboration with NVIDIA to help customers streamline the development and deployment of production-ready AI

relations.text: OCI Zettascale10クラスターは、複数のデータセンターにまたがり数十万基のNVIDIA GPUを接続
relations.text_en: OCI Zettascale10 connects hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs across multiple data centers

source.label: Oracle の発表
source.quote: OCI Zettascale10 connects hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs across multiple data centers to form multi-gigawatt clusters

relations.text: NVIDIA AI EnterpriseをOCIと統合すると発表
relations.text_en: Oracle and NVIDIA announced an integration of NVIDIA AI Enterprise with OCI

source.label: NVIDIA の発表
source.quote: Oracle and NVIDIA today announced a first-of-its-kind integration between NVIDIA accelerated computing and inference software with Oracle’s AI infrastructure

relations.text: 2026年度第2四半期の契約残高(RPO)を押し上げた新規契約の例としてNVIDIAを挙げている
relations.text_en: Cited NVIDIA among new commitments lifting RPO in Q2 FY26

source.label: Oracle 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: highlighted by new commitments from Meta, NVIDIA, and others
source.note: 決算発表の中で顧客の契約として名前が挙がっただけで、条件は示されていません。
source.note_en: Named as a customer commitment in the results release; terms are not given.

relations.text: 2026年第3四半期から、AMD Instinct MI450シリーズGPU 50,000基による一般向けAIスーパークラスターを、ハイパースケーラーとして初めて提供する
relations.text_en: Oracle will be the first hyperscaler to offer a publicly available AI supercluster of 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs from Q3 2026

source.label: AMD の発表
source.quote: Oracle will be the first hyperscaler to offer a publicly available AI supercluster powered by 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs.

relations.text: マスター・サービス契約のもとで、最大2.8GWのBloomの燃料電池システムを調達する意向
relations.text_en: Oracle intends to procure up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel cell systems under a master services agreement

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表
source.quote: Under a master services agreement, Oracle intends to procure up to 2.8 gigawatts (GW) of Bloom’s fuel cell systems.
source.note: 調達の意向であり、Bloomはデータセンターへの電力供給元です。
source.note_en: Intent to procure; Bloom is a power supplier to Oracle data centers.

relations.text: 電力提携に関連してBloomが発行したワラントをOracleが行使し、1,905,433株を取得
relations.text_en: Bloom issued Oracle a warrant tied to the on-site power partnership; Oracle completed a cashless exercise on May 1, 2026, resulting in 1,905,433 shares

source.label: Bloom Energy 10-Q(2026年第2四半期)
source.quote: On May 1, 2026 (the “Exercise Date”), Oracle completed a cashless exercise of the Warrant, resulting in the issuance of 1,905,433 shares of our common stock.

relations.text: 2026年度第2四半期の契約残高(RPO)を押し上げた新規契約の例としてMetaを挙げている
relations.text_en: Cited new RPO commitments from Meta in Q2 FY26

source.label: Oracle 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: highlighted by new commitments from Meta, NVIDIA, and others
source.note: 条件は開示されていません。
source.note_en: Terms are not disclosed.

relations.text: Applied Optoelectronicsは、2024年の売上の12.4%をOracleが占めたと記載
relations.text_en: Applied Optoelectronics reports that Oracle accounted for 12.4% of its revenue in 2024

source.label: Applied Optoelectronics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in 2024, Oracle accounted for 12.4% of our revenue
source.note: 2024年の売上に関する記載です。
source.note_en: Relates to FY2024 revenue.

relations.text: OCIのマルチクラウド・サービスがMicrosoft Azureなど競合他社の製品と連携
relations.text_en: Oracle’s OCI multicloud services work with Microsoft Azure, among other competitors’ products

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: OCI’s multicloud services work with a number of our competitors’ products, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud.

relations.text: OracleとMicrosoftがOracle Database@Azureを発表し、OCIのデータベース・サービスをAzureのデータセンターで提供
relations.text_en: Oracle and Microsoft announced Oracle Database@Azure, putting OCI database services in Azure datacenters

source.label: Microsoft の発表
source.quote: Oracle Corp and Microsoft Corp today announced Oracle Database@Azure, which gives customers direct access to Oracle database services running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and deployed in Microsoft Azure datacenters.
source.note: 2023年の発表です。
source.note_en: A 2023 announcement.

relations.text: Oracleが年次報告で、主な競合の1社としてMicrosoftを挙げている
relations.text_en: Oracle’s FY2026 10-K names Microsoft among its principal competitors

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: compete directly with certain offerings from some of the largest and most competitive companies in the world, including Adobe Systems Incorporated, Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., Intel Corporation, International Business Machines Corporation, Microsoft Corporation, Salesforce, Inc. and SAP SE, as well as other companies like Hewlett-Packard Enterprise and Workday, Inc.
source.note: 競合として挙げられた企業の一覧の中での記載で、特定の事業分野に限った記述ではありません。
source.note_en: Named in a list of competitors for Oracle offerings; not segment-specific.

relations.text: Marvell、MicrosoftとともにOCPの作業部会を設立し、データセンターのハードウェア・セキュリティ・モジュールを標準化
relations.text_en: Marvell, Microsoft and Oracle formed an OCP working group to standardize data-center hardware security modules

source.label: Marvell の発表
source.quote: As founding members of the new OCP working group, Marvell, Microsoft and Oracle will collaborate with the broader OCP community

relations.text: OCIのマルチクラウド・サービスがAmazon Web Servicesなど競合他社の製品と連携
relations.text_en: Oracle’s OCI multicloud services work with Amazon Web Services, among other competitors’ products

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: OCI’s multicloud services work with a number of our competitors’ products, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud.
source.note: AWSはAmazonの事業部門です。
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: OracleとAWSがOracle Database@AWSの一般提供開始を発表
relations.text_en: Oracle and AWS announced general availability of Oracle Database@AWS

source.label: Amazon/AWS の発表
source.quote: Oracle and Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS) today announced the general availability of OracleDatabase@AWS
source.note: AWSはAmazonの事業部門です。
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: Amazon、Google、MicrosoftからのマルチクラウドDB売上が2026年度第1四半期に1,529%増
relations.text_en: MultiCloud database revenue from Amazon, Google and Microsoft grew 1,529% in Q1 FY26

source.label: Oracle 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: MultiCloud database revenue from Amazon, Google and Microsoft grew at the incredible rate of 1,529% in Q1
source.note: AWSはAmazonの事業部門です。同じ文にGoogleとMicrosoftも挙げられています。
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com; the same sentence also names Google and Microsoft.

source.quote: compete directly with certain offerings from some of the largest and most competitive companies in the world, including Adobe Systems Incorporated, Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., Intel Corporation, International Business Machines Corporation, Microsoft Corporation, Salesforce, Inc. and SAP SE, as well as other companies like Hewlett-Packard Enterprise and Workday, Inc.

relations.text: OCIのマルチクラウド・サービスがGoogle Cloudなど競合他社の製品と連携
relations.text_en: Oracle’s OCI multicloud services work with Google Cloud, among other competitors’ products

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)

relations.text: Google Cloudと提携を拡大し、OCI Generative AIでGemini 2.5をはじめとするGoogleのAIモデルを提供
relations.text_en: Oracle and Google Cloud expanded their partnership to offer Google’s AI models, starting with Gemini 2.5, via OCI Generative AI

source.label: Oracle の発表
source.quote: Oracle and Google Cloud have expanded their partnership to offer customers access to Google’s most advanced AI models, starting with Gemini 2.5, via Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI service
source.note: Google CloudはAlphabetの事業部門です。
source.note_en: Google Cloud is a unit of Alphabet.

relations.text_en: Oracle’s FY2026 10-K names Alphabet (Google) among its principal competitors

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)

relations.text: Oracleは戦略的パートナーとしてPalantirを挙げ、Oracle Distributed CloudでPalantirを提供
relations.text_en: Oracle lists Palantir as a strategic partner, offering Palantir on Oracle Distributed Cloud

source.label: Oracle パートナーのページ
source.quote: Oracle and Palantir revolutionize data-driven operations, combining AI with sovereignty and lower costs.
source.note: 日付のないページです。
source.note_en: Undated page.

relations.text: NetAppとOracleが、OCIで動く完全マネージド型のNetAppストレージ・サービスを発表
relations.text_en: NetApp and Oracle announced a fully managed NetApp storage service native to OCI

source.label: Oracle の発表
source.quote: NetApp® (NASDAQ: NTAP), the Intelligent Data Infrastructure company, and Oracle today announced a new fully managed storage service that brings enterprise-grade NetApp storage natively to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
source.note: サービスは提供開始に向けた計画段階です。
source.note_en: The service is planned to launch.

relations.text: ArmはStargate Project(SoftBank Group、OpenAI、Oracleの合弁事業)で重要な技術パートナーに挙げられたと記載
relations.text_en: Arm’s 10-K states that SoftBank Group announced the Stargate Project, a joint venture with OpenAI and Oracle, naming Arm a key technology partner

source.label: Arm 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: SoftBank Group announced the Stargate Project, a joint venture between SoftBank Group, OpenAI and Oracle Corporation, to invest in building new AI infrastructure, where we were named as a key technology partner.
source.note: Armは正式な契約はないと記載しており、これはArmとStargateの関係です。Oracleの合弁事業として表示しています。
source.note_en: Arm reports no formal commitments; the relationship is Arm-Stargate, shown for the Oracle JV.

relations.text: Stargate Project(SoftBank Group、OpenAI、Oracleの合弁事業)に参加
relations.text_en: Arm’s 10-K describes the Stargate Project, a joint venture between SoftBank Group, OpenAI and Oracle

source.label: Arm 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: SoftBank Group announced the Stargate Project, a joint venture between SoftBank Group, OpenAI and Oracle Corporation, to invest in building new AI infrastructure
source.note: 他社(Arm)の年次報告に基づく記載です。
source.note_en: Third-party filing.

relations.text: 2025年11月25日にSoftBank GroupがAmpereの全持分を取得。Oracleは持分法で出資していたAmpereの持分を売却し、利益を計上
relations.text_en: SoftBank Group acquired all equity interests of Ampere on November 25, 2025; Oracle, an equity-method investor, sold its stake and booked a gain

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: On November 25, 2025, SoftBank Group Corp. acquired all of the equity interests of Ampere (the Ampere Acquisition).
source.note: Oracleは2026年5月31日時点でAmpereの持分を持っておらず、この出資は終了しています。
source.note_en: Oracle exited its Ampere investment (no remaining stake as of May 31, 2026); this tie has ended.

relations.text: Stargate Project(SoftBank Group、OpenAI、Oracleの合弁事業)に参加
relations.text_en: Stargate Project, a joint venture between SoftBank Group, OpenAI and Oracle, per Arm’s 10-K

source.label: Arm 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: SoftBank Group announced the Stargate Project, a joint venture between SoftBank Group, OpenAI and Oracle Corporation, to invest in building new AI infrastructure
source.note: OpenAIは未上場です。OpenAIとの関係は上場パートナー(Arm)の年次報告で確認されたもので、Oracle自身の10-Kにはその名前がありません。
source.note_en: OpenAI is not listed. The tie is confirmed by a listed partner’s (Arm) filing; Oracle’s own 10-K does not name OpenAI.

relations.text: Oracle AI Databaseで、OpenAIのChatGPTなどのLLMをOracle Database上で利用可能
relations.text_en: Oracle AI Database lets customers use LLMs including OpenAI’s ChatGPT on Oracle Database

source.label: Oracle 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: including Google’s Gemini, OpenAI’s ChatGPT, xAI’s Grok, etc.
source.note: OpenAIは未上場です。モデルの連携であり、計算資源の契約ではありません。
source.note_en: OpenAI is not listed. A model integration, not the compute contract.

source.quote: Our strategic partners include: Adobe, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft, Oracle, Palo Alto Networks, Salesforce, Samsung Electronics and SAP, among others.
